resources.string: This image is pinned. Opening another media item will unpin it. Continue?

Allow DS Gallery to show up to two images or animated GIFs above other apps. Drag to move and use two fingers to resize. Tap to show or hide the close X. Drag beyond a side edge to park it as a bubble; tap or swipe the bubble inward to restore it.
Two comparisons are already open. Close one before adding another.
Use the pin in the preview to hold a photo or GIF while browsing other media. Music, FTP and settings stay available.
Video keeps playing in a window when you open other media, Music, FTP or settings. Turn off to pause it.
